title: Local narration for people and agents
caption: Text → Siri voice → MP3
narration: Meet Voice Studio. A small Mac command line tool with a browser interface. It turns text into downloadable MP3 narration using installed Siri voices. This video's narration was made with Voice Studio itself, using Nora.

title: Install once and open the Web UI
caption: Install • Launch • Keep Terminal open
narration: Start with the one line installer at the top of the GitHub readme. You need macOS, Apple command line tools, and a downloaded natural Siri voice. The installer uses your existing encoder, or installs ffmpeg through an existing Homebrew setup. Then run the installed voice studio command. Leave Terminal open while you work.

title: Create your first recording
caption: Enter text → Choose Nora → Generate MP3
narration: In Create audio, paste your script. Choose the language and region, then an installed Siri voice. Nora is selected when available. Click Generate MP3. The audio plays when it is ready, and Download MP3 saves a copy. If your browser blocks autoplay, press Play.

title: Change the voice or speech speed
caption: After the first render, control changes regenerate automatically
narration: Move the speech speed slider left for slower speech, or right for faster speech. It changes the generated recording, not the player's playback speed. After the first successful render, changing language, voice, or speed regenerates and plays updated audio. Rapid changes are combined. Editing text alone still needs Generate MP3.

title: Give Codex or Claude a narration tool
caption: Local agent → Narration helper → Voice Studio → Saved MP3
narration: Agents with shell access on the same Mac can use the included Python helper. Ask Codex or Claude to read a script file, use Nora, and save a voiceover MP3. The helper starts Voice Studio without a browser, checks readiness, generates the recording, and shuts down its own server. Python three is required for this helper.

title: Use the local API directly
caption: Status → Generate → Download
narration: For a custom agent workflow, start Voice Studio with no open. Read the private session URL from Terminal. Send the token as a bearer authorization header. Check status, post text, a voice identifier, and rate to generate, then download the returned audio path. Run requests one at a time and keep the token private.

title: Verify the MP3 and save your work
caption: Check codec and duration • Download before stopping
narration: Use ffprobe to verify that the saved file is MP3 with a nonzero duration. Your agent can then use it in a demo, presentation, or video. The server is local to this Mac. Download recordings before stopping the CLI, because Control C deletes temporary session audio. Saved files remain yours.

title: Start with the GitHub guide
caption: github.com/PrajeetShrestha/voice-cli
narration: The GitHub project includes the installer, screenshots, a detailed usage guide, and copyable agent instructions. Start with a short script, choose Nora, and generate your first recording. The same local tool works for you and your coding agents.
